Senses.Explanation: The iron tree blossoming pictures the impossibility of flowers opening from iron. Chan verses and teaching-seat addresses make that impossible flowering occur: at New Year, under a raised staff or shout, in answers about the phrase itself, and beside other impossible images such as fire in ice.
